speaker: Lieutenant Frank Drebin
clickReplies: No report yet? Use MISSION REPORT on the agency computer. It only bites when you forget an attachment.
Report first. Conversation second. The computer is in the office; I am not your printer.
Complete it on the office computer, print it, then bring it here. Paperwork enjoys a little travel.
wrongItemReplies: That is not a report. I admire your confidence, not your filing skills.
Wrong department. Try Lost Property. Preferably while lost.
alreadySubmittedReplies: I have already filed that report. Once was quite enough.

lines: A mission report. Finally, a visitor with supporting documentation.
You included the attachments. All of them. That is either competence or a cry for help.
Filed. You may now ask questions. Brief ones. The cabinets are listening.
Now that the report is filed, I can officially acknowledge your existence.
People think an archive is where information goes to die. Nonsense. It comes here to be mislabelled.
Looking for an old file? Bring me a name, a date, or a scandal. Ideally all three.
When you're ready for more fieldwork, use NEXT MISSION. Until then, try not to alphabetise anything. I have a system.

submittedMessage: Mission report filed. You can now talk to Frank or select NEXT MISSION.
inventoryFullMessage: Your printed report is waiting. Free one inventory slot, then click Frank to collect it.
wrongReportMessage: This report belongs to a different case. Nothing has been filed.
absentMessage: The archivist is out. Apparently paperwork also has field assignments.
